evidence: retrospective post-publication, source already used by Ranke 2021 and Hansson Frank 2026
known_natal_origin: only unique nest-stage individual island and birth year, never first adult observation
destination: exactly one different island at next calendar year from capt/obs stages, if available
ambiguous: exclude individual with more than one nest year/island or next-year destinations; count exclusions
fixed_source_islands: islands listed by author population model, must equal eleven; do not select result-favorable islands
results: full counts of marked nestlings, resident and emigrant resightings, unknown followup, origin-destination edges for each cohort; no p-values or re-fitting
